sections.label: Book 32
sections.name: The Sarvamedha; prayer for wisdom and glory

verses.sa: तदेवाग्निस्तदादित्यस्तद्वायुस्तदु चन्द्रमाः। तदेव शुक्रं तद्ब्रह्म ता आपः स प्रजापतिः॥
verses.tr: tadevāgnistadādityastadvāyustadu candramāḥ tadeva śukraṃ tadbrahma tā āpaḥ sa prajāpatiḥ
verses.en: Agni is That; the Sun is That; Vayu and Chandramas are That. The Bright is That; Brahma is That, those Waters, that Prajapati.

verses.sa: सर्वे निमेषा जज्ञिरे विद्युतः पुरुषादधि। नैनमूर्ध्वं न तिर्यञ्चं न मध्ये परि जग्रभत्॥
verses.tr: sarve nimeṣā jajñire vidyutaḥ puruṣādadhi nainamūrdhvaṃ na tiryañcaṃ na madhye pari jagrabhat
verses.en: All twinkling of the eyelid sprang from Purusha, resplendent One. No one hath comprehended him above, across, or in the midst.

verses.sa: न तस्य प्रतिमा अस्ति यस्य नाम महद्यशः। हिरण्यगर्भ इत्येषः मा मा हिंसीदित्येषा यस्मान्न जात इत्येषः॥
verses.tr: na tasya pratimā asti yasya nāma mahadyaśaḥ hiraṇyagarbha ityeṣaḥ mā mā hiṃsīdityeṣā yasmānna jāta ityeṣaḥ
verses.en: There is no counterpart of him whose glory verily is great. In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, etc. Let not him harm me, etc. Than whom there is no other born, etc.

verses.sa: एषो ह देवः प्रदिशोऽनु सर्वाः पूर्वो ह जातः स उ गर्भे अन्तः। स एव जातः स जनिष्यमाणः प्रत्यङ् जनास्तिष्ठति सर्वतोमुखः॥
verses.tr: eṣo ha devaḥ pradiśo'nu sarvāḥ pūrvo ha jātaḥ sa u garbhe antaḥ sa eva jātaḥ sa janiṣyamāṇaḥ pratyaṅ janāstiṣṭhati sarvatomukhaḥ
verses.en: This very God pervadeth all the regions; yea, born aforetime, in the womb he dwelleth. He verily born and to be born hereafter meeteth his offspring, facing all directions.

verses.sa: यस्माज्जातं न पुरा किं चनैव य आबभूव भुवनानि विश्वा। प्रजापतिः प्रजया संरराणस्त्रीणि ज्योतींषि सचते स षोडशी॥
verses.tr: yasmājjātaṃ na purā kiṃ canaiva ya ābabhūva bhuvanāni viśvā prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃrarāṇastrīṇi jyotīṃṣi sacate sa ṣoḍaśī
verses.en: Before whom naught whatever sprang to being; who with his presence aids all living creatures, Prajapati, rejoicing in his offspring, he, Shodaff, maintains the Three great Lustres.

verses.sa: येन द्यौरुग्रा पृथिवी च दृढा येन स्व स्तभितं येन नाकः। यो अन्तरिक्षे रजसो विमानः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yena dyaurugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḍhā yena sva stabhitaṃ yena nākaḥ yo antarikṣe rajaso vimānaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: By whom:\ the heavens are strong and earth stands firmly, by whom light's realm and sky-vault are supported; By whom the regions in mid-air were measured. What God shall we adore with our oblation

verses.sa: यं क्रन्दसी अवसा तस्तभाने अभ्यैक्षेतां मनसा रेजमाने। यत्राधि सूर उदितो विभाति कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम। आपो ह यद्बृहतीर्यश्चिदापः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ krandasī avasā tastabhāne abhyaikṣetāṃ manasā rejamāne yatrādhi sūra udito vibhāti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema āpo ha yadbṛhatīryaścidāpaḥ
verses.en: To whom, supported by his help, two armies embattled look while trembling in their spirit, Where over them the risen Sun is shining. What God shall we adore with our oblation? What time the mighty waters, etc. He in his might &\xx surveyed, etc.

verses.sa: वेनस्तत्पश्यन्निहितं गुहा सद्यत्र विश्वं भवत्येकनीडम्। तस्मिन्निदं सं च वि चैति सर्वं स ओतः प्रोतश्च विभूः प्रजासु॥
verses.tr: venastatpaśyannihitaṃ guhā sadyatra viśvaṃ bhavatyekanīḍam tasminnidaṃ saṃ ca vi caiti sarvaṃ sa otaḥ protaśca vibhūḥ prajāsu
verses.en: The Sage beholdeth That mysterious Being wherein this All hath found one only dwelling. Therein unites the Whole, and thence it issues: far-spread it is the warp and woof in creatures.

verses.sa: प्र तद्वोचेदमृतं नु विद्वान् गन्धर्वो धाम विभृतं गुहा सत्। त्रीणि पदानि निहिता गुहास्य यस्तानि वेद स पितुः पिताऽसत्॥
verses.tr: pra tadvocedamṛtaṃ nu vidvān gandharvo dhāma vibhṛtaṃ guhā sat trīṇi padāni nihitā guhāsya yastāni veda sa pituḥ pitā'sat
verses.en: Knowing Eternity, may the Gandharva declare that station, parted, kept in secret. Three steps thereof in mystery are hidden: he who knows these shall be the father's father.

verses.sa: स नो बन्धुर्जनिता स विधाता धामानि वेद भुवनानि विश्वा। यत्र देवा अमृतमानशानास्तृतीये धामन्नध्यैरयन्त॥
verses.tr: sa no bandhurjanitā sa vidhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā yatra devā amṛtamānaśānāstṛtīye dhāmannadhyairayanta
verses.en: He is our kin, our Father and Begetter: he knows all be ings and all Ordinances, In whom the Gods obtaining life eternal have risen upward to the third high station.

verses.sa: परीत्य भूतानि परीत्य लोकान् परीत्य सर्वाः प्रदिशो दिशश्च। उपस्थाय प्रथमजामृतस्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानमभि सं विवेश॥
verses.tr: parītya bhūtāni parītya lokān parītya sarvāḥ pradiśo diśaśca upasthāya prathamajāmṛtasyātmanā''tmānamabhi saṃ viveśa
verses.en: Having encompassed round existing creatures, the worlds and all the Quarters and Mid-quarters, Having approached the first-born Child of Order he with his Self into The Self hath entered.

verses.sa: परि द्यावापृथिवी सद्य इत्वा परि लोकान् परि दिशः परि स्वः। ऋतस्य तन्तुं विततं विचृत्य तदपश्यत्तदभवत्तदासीत्॥
verses.tr: pari dyāvāpṛthivī sadya itvā pari lokān pari diśaḥ pari svaḥ ṛtasya tantuṃ vitataṃ vicṛtya tadapaśyattadabhavattadāsīt
verses.en: Having gone swiftly round the earth and heaven, around the worlds, around the sky, the Quarters, Having spread out the lengthened thread of Order, he dews, and he becomes and is That Being.
To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives Wisdom, have I drawn near in prayer.

verses.sa: यां मेधां देवगणाः पितरश्चोपासते। तया मामद्य मेधयाऽग्ने मेधाविनं कुरु स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yāṃ medhāṃ devagaṇāḥ pitaraścopāsate tayā māmadya medhayā'gne medhāvinaṃ kuru svāhā
verses.en: That wisdom which the Companies of Gods, and Fathers, recognize. Even with that intelligence, O Agni, make me wise to-day. All-hail!

verses.sa: मेधां मे वरुणो ददातु मेधामग्निः प्रजापतिः। मेधामिन्द्रश्च वायुश्च मेधां धाता ददातु मे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: medhāṃ me varuṇo dadātu medhāmagniḥ prajāpatiḥ medhāmindraśca vāyuśca medhāṃ dhātā dadātu me svāhā
verses.en: Varuna grant me wisdom! grant it Agni and Prajapati! Wisdom may Indra, Vayu grant. May the Creator grant it me. All-hail!

verses.sa: इदं मे ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं चोभे श्रियमश्नुताम्। मयि देवा दधतु श्रियमुत्तमां तस्यै ते स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: idaṃ me brahma ca kṣatraṃ cobhe śriyamaśnutām mayi devā dadhatu śriyamuttamāṃ tasyai te svāhā
verses.en: Let these the Priests and Nobles both enjoy the splendour that is mine. Best splendour may the Gods bestow on me. To thee, that splendour, hail!
